newsitem.title: USA: PG&E delays Diablo Canyon 1,087 MW nuke restart.
newsitem.headline: PG&E delays Diablo Canyon 1,087 MW nuke restart.

text.p: Restart of the 1,087 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at the Diablo Canyon nuclear plant in central California has been delayed until the weekend, a spokesman for Pacific Gas & Electric Co (PG&E) said on Wednesday.
The company said earlier that the unit, which has been shut for scheduled refueling since April 19, was expected to begin delivering power to the regional grid sometime on Thursday.
The PG&E spokesman did not provide an explanation for the decision to push back the schedule to Saturday or Sunday.
